data.title: Targeted by Trump, ICC awarded top EU rights prize
data.description: STRASBOURG, France - Facing US sanctions, the International Criminal Court on Thursday was awarded the European Union’s top rights prize, in a show of support that risks upsetting President Donald Trump.

data.title: ONE Championship: Itsuki Hirata finds her way back with revenge over Jihin
data.description: Four years and seven months after Jihin Radzuan handed her a first professional defeat, Itsuki Hirata finally had her revenge. After everything that followed that night in Singapore, she also had reason to believe her career was moving forward again.

data.title: CP Group, True showcase ‘frontier tech’ at CP Innovation Exposition 2026
data.description: What will the future look like now that “frontier tech” — cutting-edge technologies once confined to research laboratories — is ready for real-world commercial applications? CP Group and True Corporation, led by Ekaraj Panjavinin, head of research and innovation at True Corporation Plc, explored this question at CP Innovation Exposition 2026. The event brought together technology partners for a panel discussion entitled “The New Frontier of Technology in Action”.

data.title: Ex-MP raises more concerns about gambling site
data.description: Former Democrat MP Sirichok Sopha has urged law enforcement to trace funds linked to Shuffle.com, a gambling site blocked in Thailand, after the digital asset exchange Bitkub confirmed transactions exceeding 100 million baht involving 49 customers.

data.title: AI Is Changing More Than Our Jobs. It Is Changing How Organisations Create Value
data.description: Will AI take our jobs?

data.title: Leaders Discuss Roles in Peace and Reconciliation at “One South Sudan Peace Conference”
data.description: JUBA, South Sudan, Oct. 8 — The “One South Sudan Peace Conference: Beyond Our Camps, Bridging Our Future,” jointly hosted by the National Council of Traditional Authority Leaders (NCOTAL), the Community Empowerment for Progress Organization (CEPO), the Center for Inclusive Governance, Peace and Justice (CIGPJ), and HWPL, was held at the University of Juba.

data.title: Thailand, Beyond a Destination
data.description: As lives become less bound by borders, the concept of where we live is changing. Flexible work, greater connectivity and easier international travel allow global citizens to integrate where they were born, work and choose to build their life.

data.title: Son of Aung San Suu Kyi gets first phone call in five years
data.description: YANGON - The son of Aung San Suu Kyi said he spoke on Thursday to the detained former democratic leader of Myanmar for the first time in more than five years.

data.title: China slams ‘Cold War mentality’ in EU Arctic plan
data.description: BEIJING - China says it opposes “using Cold War mentality” to stoke conflict over the Arctic, after the European Union linked Beijing’s cooperation with Russia in the region to security concerns.

data.title: Luxury is the ability to escape
data.description: After years of conspicuous consumption, luxury is changing .

data.title: Customs to inspect all scrap metal containers for e-waste
data.description: The Thai Customs Department is physically inspecting every container declared as metal scrap as it steps up enforcement against illegal electronic waste imports, which have polluted the environment and threatened local livelihoods in the country’s eastern provinces.

data.title: Targeted by Trump, ICC in running for top EU rights prize
data.description: STRASBOURG — Facing US sanctions, the International Criminal Court is up for the European Union's top rights prize Thursday, with supporters pressing its case as a show of support for a fraying rules-based world order.

data.title: Lula seeks tit-for-tat annulment of Bolsonaro election candidacy
data.description: BRASíLIA - Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's campaign requested the disqualification of right-wing rival Flavio Bolsonaro from the presidential race on Wednesday, a day after his opponent did the same.

data.title: Chinese suspects in Dubai abductions arrested in Bangkok
data.description: Two Chinese men have been arrested at luxury condominiums in Bangkok in connection with the abduction and detention of three people who were found dead in Dubai in June.

data.title: PTT announces CEO and president recruitment
data.description: PTT Public Company Limited (PTT) has announced a public invite of applications for the position of chief executive officer and president in accordance with its nomination procedure.

data.title: Thailand races to protect data after PHP alert
data.description: Thai authorities have urged organisations to urgently update websites and systems using PHP to prevent potential personal data leaks, with universities and medical school hospitals told to prioritise patient records and student databases.

data.title: Wrong anthems played at Asian Para Games after mishap-marred Asian Games
data.description: TOKYO — Wrong national anthems were played three times at the Asian Para Games in Japan's Nagoya this week, prompting the mayor to apologise just days after the city hosted the mishap-plagued Asian Games.

data.title: Heat turned down on holy basil controversy
data.description: Thailand’s agriculture minister has stepped in to calm the nerves of farmers and foodies about access to holy basil for the country’s beloved phat kaphrao stir-fry.

data.title: Bangkok office market faces fresh supply amid high vacancies
data.description: Bangkok has 1.6 million sq m of vacant offices, with another 119,000 sq m due in the fourth quarter, keeping pressure on landlords.

data.title: Thai agencies warn alligator gar eggs remain poisonous after cooking
data.description: The public is advised to avoid the eggs and go to hospital immediately if symptoms develop after eating them, informing doctors what they consumed.

data.title: Focus turns to businesses as Indonesia fire haze worsens
data.description: After months of fires in Indonesia that have caused thick regional haze, attention is turning to whether companies can be held accountable for the blazes and resulting air pollution.

data.title: Seoul sees no signs of new North Korean weapons on border
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea's military said on Thursday it had seen no signs of newly deployed North Korean weapons on their shared border, hours after Pyongyang said new "counter means" would be put on alert along its length.

data.title: Canadian publisher drops novelist after AI confirmation
data.description: MONTREAL - The publisher of the top-selling Haitian-Canadian writer Thelyson Orelien says it has confirmed that he used artificial intelligence to help write his novel.

data.title: 125 laughing gas cylinders seized from Bangkok condo
data.description: Police have arrested a 19-year-old man and seized 125 cylinders of nitrous oxide, commonly known as laughing gas, and related items in a raid on a condominium in Lat Phrao district of Bangkok.

data.title: Thai banks report 3.60% decline in combined nine-month profits
data.description: Fee income, loan growth and cost controls cushion pressure from falling interest rates, with results varying among 10 listed banking groups.

data.title: Man U humiliated as Arsenal deny Bayern in Champions League
data.description: Manchester United were hammered 4-1 by Como in the Champions League on Wednesday as the pressure increased on beleaguered manager Michael Carrick, while a late Declan Rice equaliser earned Arsenal a 2-2 draw away to Bayern Munich.

data.title: MotoGP riders to bid ‘emotional’ farewell to Phillip Island
data.description: PHILLIP ISLAND, Australia - Seven-time world champion Marc Marquez admits it will be “emotional” this weekend as one of MotoGP’s most iconic circuits at Phillip Island hosts its last race after nearly three decades.

data.title: Chinese fugitive’s toddler registered as Thai child of ‘fake father’
data.description: PATTAYA - Immigration police say a Chinese man wanted in his home country for running a major gambling business had his biological daughter registered as the child of a Thai man to obtain Thai nationality.

data.title: Air travellers alerted as typhoon warning issued in Taiwan
data.description: Thai Airways International has advised passengers on flights to and from Taipei and Kaohsiung between Thursday and Saturday to check schedules as they could be disrupted by the approaching Typhoon Champi.

data.title: Crisis at MGI with a 92.6% drop in its shares forces Nawat to account to the SEC
data.description: The fall from the peak, the legal claims and the investment of 135 million baht in Sabuy place MGI’s management before questions that deserve a documentary examination.

data.title: Washington’s $14bn arms sale to Taiwan stalls
data.description: TAIPEI - Taiwan has been waiting months for US President Donald Trump to approve a $14 billion sale of weapons and equipment, which the island democracy would use to fend off a potential Chinese attack.

data.title: US orders embassy staff, families to leave Saudi Arabia
data.description: RIYADH - Washington has ordered non-essential US embassy staff and their families to leave Saudi Arabia, the State Department said on Wednesday, as the kingdom comes under sustained deadly attacks by Yemen’s Houthis.

data.title: New rescue bid as ‘celebrity shark’ returns to Busan canal
data.description: SEOUL - A shark that became a viral sensation after getting stuck in a South Korean canal returned hours after being coaxed out, authorities said on Thursday, prompting another attempt to guide it back to the sea.

data.title: Police raid Pathum Thani bar over prostitution
data.description: PATHUM THANI: Police have arrested a 44-year-old bar operator and detained five Vietnamese women during a raid on a beer bar in Thanyaburi district over alleged prostitution and illegal employment.
